setArbitrator(address).details: Calling again reschedules: the previously pending change is      replaced and the deadline is pushed out.

ARBITRATOR_CHANGE_DELAY().notice: How long an arbitrator change must wait before it is active.

approveWork(uint256).notice: Client confirms the work is satisfactory.

cancelArbitratorChange().notice: Cancel a pending arbitrator change. Owner only.

cancelEscrow(uint256).notice: Client cancels the escrow. Unfunded escrows cancel any time;         funded ones only after expiry and before work is submitted, in         which case the deposit is refunded to the client.

claimAfterExpiry(uint256).notice: After expiry, the freelancer can claim the locked funds when work         was submitted and the client never approved or released them.         Once the client has approved, the freelancer's path is         releaseFunds (callable by the freelancer) — not a unilateral         claim past the timelock.

confirmArbitrator().notice: Confirm a pending arbitrator change after the delay elapsed.         No-op (returns the current arbitrator) when nothing is pending.

createEscrow(address,uint256).notice: Create an escrow with the configured default duration.

createEscrowWithDeadline(address,uint256.notice: Create an escrow with a custom expiry duration in seconds. The         expiry clock starts when the client deposits funds, so a client         can never fund at the last moment and leave the freelancer no         time to submit work.

depositFunds(uint256).notice: Client locks the escrow amount into the contract. The expiry         clock starts here (expiresAt is set at funding), so the         freelancer always has the full duration to submit work.

disputeEscrow(uint256).notice: Either party can raise a dispute while funds are locked.

releaseFunds(uint256).notice: Release the funds to the freelancer. The client releases after         approving; once approved, the freelancer can also release so a         stalling client cannot freeze payment indefinitely.

rescueTokens(address,address).notice: Recover tokens sent directly to the contract by mistake. For         the escrow token (USDC), only the amount *above* what open         escrows lock can be rescued, so client funds are never at risk.         Other tokens are rescued in full. Owner only.

resolveDispute(uint256,bool).notice: Arbitrator resolves a dispute: favorFreelancer pays the         freelancer, otherwise the client is refunded.

setArbitrator(address).notice: Schedule an arbitrator change. The new arbitrator becomes active         only after confirmArbitrator is called once ARBITRATOR_CHANGE_DELAY         has elapsed, so the owner cannot swap the arbitrator mid-dispute         to control an outcome. Owner only.

setDefaultDuration(uint256).notice: Set the default expiry duration for new escrows. Owner only.

setMaxEscrowsPerClient(uint256).notice: Set how many escrows a single wallet may create (spam cap).         Owner only. Counts every escrow ever created by the wallet.

submitWork(uint256).notice: Freelancer marks the work as delivered.
